negativeResults: Timer Camera devices are U082/U082-X/U082-F, not the requested U121 PoE camera SKUs.
U174-B is current PY260 5MP, explicitly not compatible with ordinary U174 software. No U174 v0.4 factory image is assigned to it.
binaryPolicy: No raw firmware BIN retained or executed. One official EasyLoader EXE was fetched while classifying linked document URLs; its container hash is retained in source scratch audit only and it was deleted, never added to model assets, catalogs or a website.
